Perfect! The implementation is complete and fully tested. Let me provide a summary of what was implemented:

## Implementation Summary

I've successfully implemented the post revisions feature ("undo" for authors) for the Agents On Guren app. Here's what was added:

### Database & Schema
- Created `post_revisions` table with columns: `id`, `post_id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `created_at`
- Foreign key on `post_id` references `posts.id` with ON DELETE CASCADE to automatically delete revisions when a post is deleted
- Migration: `db/migrations/20260925052050_add_post_revisions_table/migration.sql`

### Models
- **PostRevision** (`app/Models/PostRevision.ts`): New model with `belongsTo` relationship to `Post`
- **Post** (`app/Models/Post.ts`): Updated to include `hasMany` relationship to `PostRevision`

### Controller Actions
- **`PostController.update()`**: Modified to save the previous version as a revision before updating the post
- **`PostController.revisions()`**: New action that lists all revisions for a post (newest first) with authorization check
- **`PostController.restore()`**: New action that restores a previous revision and creates a new revision of the current content

### Routes
- `GET /posts/:id/revisions` → `PostController.revisions()` (name: `posts.revisions`)
- `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` → `PostController.restore()` (name: `posts.revisions.restore`)
- Both routes require authentication and only allow the post's author (via `PostPolicy`)

### Authorization (PostPolicy)
- Added `viewRevisions()`: Only the post's author can view revisions
- Added `updateRevisions()`: Only the post's author can restore revisions
- Guests are redirected to login, non-authors receive 403 Forbidden

### Pages
- **Revisions.tsx**: Displays the revision history with title, timestamp, and restore button for each revision
- **Show.tsx**: Updated to add "Revisions" link for post authors

### Tests
Comprehensive test coverage including:
- No revision created on post creation
- Revision created when post is edited
- Revisions returned in newest-first order
- Authorization enforcement (403 for non-authors)
- Authentication requirement (guests cannot access)
- Restore creates new revision of current content
- 404 for revisions from different posts
- Cascade delete removes revisions when post is deleted

All contract requirements are met:
- ✅ Table `post_revisions` with correct columns
- ✅ `GET /posts/:id/revisions` returns props with `revisions: [{ id, title, createdAt }]`
- ✅ `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` restores and redirects
- ✅ Authorization: 403 for non-authors, redirects for guests, 404 for wrong post
- ✅ Delete cascade removes all revisions

**All tests pass** (`bun test`: 14 pass) and **guren gate is clean** (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test all pass).
